> See [docs/TEST-PLAN.md](https://github.com/samuelnyamukapa/complete-migration-toolkit/blob/main/docs/TEST-PLAN.md) for what is tested today. Don't paste secrets or real customer data here.

**What isn't covered**

What could break without any test noticing? Name the command, adapter, check or pilot step.

**Risk**

What could go wrong if it stays untested? Who would notice, and when?

**Suggested case**

A test or case that would cover it. A sketch is fine: the request or the steps, and what should happen.
